meta.description: Convert US Fluid Ounce (fl oz) to US Cup (cup) instantly. 1 fl oz = 0.125 cup. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert us fluid ounces (fl oz) to us cups (cup) instantly. Both measure volume, so the relationship is strictly linear: each us fluid ounce equals 0.125 us cups. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One us fluid ounce is equal to **0.125 us cups**. To go the other way, one us cup equals **8 us fluid ounces**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> us cups = us fluid ounces × 0.125

Worked example — converting 10 us fluid ounces:

10 × 0.125 = **1.25 cup**.

To invert, divide by 0.125 (or multiply by 8).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 fl oz ≈ 0.125 cup. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. US Fluid Ounce and US Cup both measure volume; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many us cups are in 1 us fluid ounce?
**A:** 0.125 us cups.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert fl oz to cup?
**A:** us cups = us fluid ounces × 0.125.

**Q:** How do I convert cup back to fl oz?
**A:** Multiply by 8 (or divide by 0.125).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this fl oz to cup converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
